title: Ramani Kalyanam
plot_overview: Follows a visually impaired girl and a boy who cannot walk as their lives intersect through a matchmaking arrangement. Their growing connection is shaped by challenges and the people around them.
will_you_like_this: If you want an emotionally grounded story about connection and perseverance, Ramani Kalyanam may resonate, but Not for you if you prefer fast-paced action or comedy-driven romance.
review_summary: Pros: heartfelt character journey; engaging premise; focus on resilience | Cons: limited plot breadth; matchmaking setup may feel slow
